name: grain-gradient-blob
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Grain Gradient style. Blob variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#0A0A0A, #FFD66B, #DB4B8F, #3F3CBB). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
